monseigneur.definition:
n. My lord; -- a title in France of a person of high
   birth or rank; as, Monseigneur the Prince, or Monseigneur the
   Archibishop. It was given, specifically, to the dauphin, before the
   Revolution of 1789. (Abbrev. Mgr.)
